en.s: The conquest of Cheng-Han by Jin, or the conquest of Han by Jin, was a military campaign launched by the Eastern Jin dynasty against the Cheng-Han dynasty from 10 December 346 to April 347 during the Sixteen Kingdoms period of China. en.s: The Cisplatine War was an armed conflict fought in the 1820s between the Empire of Brazil and the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata over control of the Banda Oriental following its annexation by Brazil as the Cisplatina province. It was fought in the aftermath of the United Provinces' and Brazil's independence from Spain and Portugal, respectively, and resulted in the independence of Cisplatina as the Oriental State of Uruguay. In 1816, the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves carried out an invasion of the Banda Oriental and, after defeating the local resistance led by José Gervasio Artigas, annexed it under the name of Cisplatina. After Brazil's independence in 1822, Cisplatina remained as part of Brazil. Wishing to gain control of the region, the United Provinces sent a diplomatic mission to Brazil in 1823 to negotiate a peaceful Brazilian withdrawal, but it failed. In 1825, a group of patriots known as the Thirty-Three Orientals, supported by the Argentine government and led by Juan Antonio Lavalleja, launched a rebellion against Brazil. On 25 August of that year, in the Congress of Florida, they declared Cisplatina's independence from Brazil and its unification with the United Provinces. After a series of initial skirmishes, they defeated the Brazilians at the battles of Rincón and Sarandí, prompting the Argentine Congress to proclaim Cisplatina reintegrated into the United Provinces on 25 October. In response, Brazil declared war on the United Provinces on 10 December 1825 and imposed a naval blockade on the River Plate.

zh.s: 西斯普拉蒂纳战争是19世纪20年代巴西帝国与拉普拉塔联合省围绕东方岸省控制权爆发的武装冲突。1816年，葡萄牙、巴西和阿尔加维联合王国入侵东方岸省，击败由何塞·赫瓦西奥·阿蒂加斯领导的当地抵抗力量后，将其并入巴西，改称西斯普拉蒂纳省。1822年巴西独立后，西斯普拉蒂纳仍属巴西。1823年，拉普拉塔联合省试图通过外交谈判促使巴西撤军，但没有成功。1825年，阿根廷政府支持胡安·安东尼奥·拉瓦列哈领导的“三十三东方人”起义军反抗巴西。8月25日，起义军在佛罗里达议会宣布西斯普拉蒂纳脱离巴西独立，并与拉普拉塔联合省合并。起义军在林孔和萨兰迪战役中击败巴西军队后，阿根廷国会于10月25日宣布西斯普拉蒂纳重新并入拉普拉塔联合省。巴西于1825年12月10日向拉普拉塔联合省宣战，并封锁拉普拉塔河口。战争最终以西斯普拉蒂纳独立、建立乌拉圭东方共和国告终。

en.s: The Siege of Plevna, or Siege of Pleven, was a major battle of the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–1878, fought by the joint army of Russia and Romania against the Ottoman Empire. zh.s: 威尔士亲王号与反击号沉没事件是第二次世界大战太平洋战争中的一场海战。1941年12月10日，日本海军的陆基轰炸机和鱼雷轰炸机在马来亚东岸彭亨州关丹附近、狮城以北海域击沉了英国皇家海军战列舰威尔士亲王号和战列巡洋舰反击号。

en.t: The Battle of Guam was an engagement during the Pacific War in World War II that took place from 8 to 10 December 1941 on Guam in the Mariana Islands between Japan and the United States
en.s: The Battle of Guam was an engagement during the Pacific War in World War II that took place from 8 to 10 December 1941 on Guam in the Mariana Islands between Japan and the United States. The American garrison was defeated by Japanese forces on 10 December, which resulted in an occupation until the Second Battle of Guam in 1944.

zh.s: 关岛战役是第二次世界大战太平洋战争中的一场战斗，于1941年12月8日至10日在马里亚纳群岛的关岛爆发，交战双方为日本和美国。美军驻军于12月10日被日军击败，关岛随后被占领，直到1944年的第二次关岛战役才收复。

en.s: The Declaration by United Nations was the main treaty that formalized the Allies of World War II and was signed by 47 national governments between 1942 and 1945. On 1 January 1942, during the Arcadia Conference in Washington D.C., the Allied "Big Four"—the United States, the United Kingdom, the Soviet Union, and China—signed a short document which later came to be known as the United Nations Declaration, and the day after the representatives of 22 other nations added their signatures.
en.n: World War II: Government of Poland in exile send Raczyński's Note (the first official report on the Holocaust) to 26 governments who signed the Declaration by United Nations.

zh.s: 《联合国宣言》是正式确立第二次世界大战同盟国关系的主要条约，1942年至1945年间由47个国家政府签署。1942年1月1日，在华盛顿特区举行的阿卡迪亚会议期间，美、英、苏、中四国签署了一份简短文件，后来称为《联合国宣言》；次日，另外22国的代表也签署了文件。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战期间，波兰流亡政府向26个签署《联合国宣言》的政府递交拉琴斯基照会，这是首份关于大屠杀的官方报告。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 10 December 1949. All 121 seats in the House of Representatives, and 42 of the 60 seats in the Senate were up for election. The incumbent Australian Labor Party led by Prime Minister of Australia Ben Chifley was defeated by the opposition Liberal Party of Australia led by Robert Menzies with coalition partner the Country Party led by Arthur Fadden. Menzies broke new ground in using the radio as his primary method of reaching voters. The number of MPs in both houses had been increased at the election, and single transferable vote under a proportional voting system had been introduced in the Senate.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于1949年12月10日举行联邦大选。众议院全部121席以及参议院60席中的42席进行改选。时任总理本·奇夫利领导的澳大利亚工党败给反对党自由党；自由党领袖罗伯特·孟席斯与阿瑟·法登领导的乡村党结盟参选。孟席斯开创先例，主要通过广播联系选民。此次选举增加了两院议员人数，参议院还开始采用比例代表制的单记可让渡投票制。

Arab nationalists of the NLF made a grenade attack against the British High Commissioner, Sir Kennedy Trevaskis, immediately killing one person, a local woman, and injuring 50 others. George Henderson, the assistant high commissioner, saved Sir Kennedy's life by pushing him out of the way.

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 10 December 1977. All 124 seats in the House of Representatives, and 34 of the 64 seats in the Senate, were up for election. en.s: The very first Iranian Assembly of Experts election was held on December 10, 1982 to elect all 82 members in 24 constituencies. 18,013,061 citizens voted in the elections, marking a 77.38% turnout. Out of 168 individuals registered to run, 146 (86.90%) were qualified allowed to do so. Held in two-round system, 76 seats were decided in the first round, as well as 7 in the second round. Experts winning the elections made decisive resolutions, including electing Hussein-Ali Montazeri as the first and only "Deputy Supreme Leader of Iran" (Persian: قائم‌مقام رهبری‎‎) in May 1985, deposing him in November 1987, and electing the new Supreme Leader in June 1989.

zh.s: 伊朗于1982年12月10日首次举行专家会议选举，选出82名成员，分属24个选区。共有18,013,061人投票，投票率为77.38%。登记参选者共168人，其中146人（86.90%）获得参选资格。选举分两轮进行：76个席位在第一轮选出，另有7个席位在第二轮选出。新当选成员随后作出多项重要决定，包括1985年5月推选侯赛因-阿里·蒙塔泽里为伊朗首位、也是唯一一位“副最高领袖”，1987年11月将其免职，以及1989年6月选出新任最高领袖。

en.t: Raúl Alfonsín (pictured) became the first democratically elected president of Argentina to take office after more than seven years of military dictatorship
en.s: Raúl Ricardo Alfonsín (Spanish pronunciation: [raˈul alfonˈsin] ; 12 March 1927 – 31 March 2009) was an Argentine lawyer and statesman who served as president of Argentina from 10 December 1983 to 8 July 1989. He was the first democratically elected president after the National Reorganization Process. en.s: On December 10, 1987, a stampede occurred at the Lujiazui ferry terminal in Shanghai, China. The main cause for the stampede was a severe fog that continued for hours and limited visibility to only 30 meters. This caused the ferry service to be suspended, leading to a crowd which was anxious to leave; as soon as the ferry service was restored, the crowd hurried to board the ferry, causing a stampede.

en.s: Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan (Arabic: زايد بن سلطان آل نهيان, romanized: Zāyid bin Sulṭān Āl Nahyān; 6 May 1918 – 2 November 2004) was an Emirati politician, philanthropist, and the founding father of the United Arab Emirates. en.s: K-1 World Grand Prix 2000 Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. It was the eighth K-1 Grand Prix final, involving eight of the world's top fighters, with all bouts fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs). The eight finalists were a mixture of invitees, some of whom had been at the previous year's final, or had qualified via preliminary tournaments (for more detail on this see bulleted list below). As well as tournament bouts there were also two 'Super Fights', one involving Japanese middleweight star Takayuki Kohiruimaki against Wilreid Montargne, fought under K-1 MAX Rules (70 kg/152 lbs), the other involving UFC legend Frank Shamrock against Elvis Sinosic in a kickboxing match fought under K-1 Rules.

zh.s: 2000年K-1世界大奖赛决赛是由K-1组织主办的踢拳赛事，也是第八届K-1大奖赛决赛，共有8名世界顶尖选手参赛。所有赛事按K-1规则（100千克／156—220磅）进行。8名决赛选手中，有人受邀参赛，也有人参加过上一年的决赛或通过预选赛晋级。赛事除大奖赛对阵外还安排了两场超级战：日本中量级明星小比类卷贵之对阵威尔弗里德·蒙塔涅，按K-1 MAX规则（70千克／152磅）进行；UFC名将弗兰克·沙姆洛克则与埃尔维斯·西诺西奇进行一场按K-1规则进行的踢拳赛。

en.s: Sosoliso Airlines Flight 1145 (SO1145/OSL1145) was a scheduled Nigerian domestic passenger flight from Nigeria's capital of Abuja (ABV) to Port Harcourt (PHC). en.s: A special election for Massachusetts's 5th congressional district took place on December 10, 2013, due to the resignation of Democratic Congressman Ed Markey following his election to the United States Senate in a special election on June 25, 2013. en.s: General elections were held in Mauritius on 10 December 2014. Results gave the opposition coalition of Alliance Lepep an upset victory, securing 47 of the directly elected seats under the leadership of Sir Anerood Jugnauth. The Alliance de l'Unité et de la Modernité, composed of the Labour Party and the Mauritian Militant Movement, led by incumbent prime minister, Navin Ramgoolam, only won a total of 13 directly elected seats.

en.s: MLS Cup 2016 was the 21st edition of the MLS Cup, the championship match of Major League Soccer (MLS), played on December 10, 2016. The soccer match was hosted at BMO Field in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, and contested by Toronto FC and Seattle Sounders FC. It was the second final to be hosted in Toronto, after 2010, and the first there since the cup transitioned away from neutral-site venues.

zh.t: 2016年美国职业足球大联盟杯决赛
zh.s: 2016年美国职业足球大联盟杯决赛是MLS杯第21届决赛，于2016年12月10日在加拿大安大略省多伦多的BMO球场举行，由多伦多FC对阵西雅图海湾人。这是多伦多第二次承办决赛，此前一次是在2010年；也是MLS杯改为不再在中立场地举办后，首次在多伦多举行决赛。

en.t: John Kennedy wins Louisiana’s United States Senate runoff
en.s: On December 10, 2016, Republican John Kennedy defeated Democrat Foster Campbell in Louisiana’s runoff election for the United States Senate. The runoff followed a first round in which no candidate won a majority.

zh.t: 约翰·肯尼迪赢得路易斯安那州联邦参议员决选

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Venezuela on 10 December 2017, to elect 335 mayors throughout Venezuela, as well as the governor of the state of Zulia. This was the first municipal election held since 2013, when elections were delayed from 2012 following the death of Hugo Chávez. The election resulted in many members of the United Socialist Party of Venezuela (the PSUV, created by Hugo Chávez) being elected as heads of municipal governments throughout Venezuela.

zh.s: 委内瑞拉于2017年12月10日举行市政选举，选出全国335个市镇的市长以及苏利亚州州长。这是自2013年以来首次举行市政选举；此前，原定于2012年举行的选举因乌戈·查韦斯去世而推迟。选举后，委内瑞拉统一社会主义党（PSUV，查韦斯创建的政党）有许多成员当选市长。

en.s: A leadership election for the presidency of The Republicans (LR) was held on 10 December 2017, the first since the refoundation of the party in 2015, before which it was known as the Union for a Popular Movement (UMP), and seventh overall including the UMP congresses. The leadership election followed the 2017 presidential election, in which its candidate François Fillon, the party nominee after winning the 2016 presidential primary, was eliminated in the first round.

zh.s: 法国共和党（LR）于2017年12月10日举行党主席选举。这是该党2015年重组后首次选举党主席；重组前，该党名为人民运动联盟（UMP）。若将UMP时期的党代表大会选举也计算在内，这是第七次党魁选举。此次选举是在2017年法国总统选举后举行的；共和党候选人弗朗索瓦·菲永先在赢得2016年党内初选后代表该党参选，但在总统选举首轮遭淘汰。

en.s: The 2017 Corsican territorial elections were held on 3 and 10 December 2017 to elect 63 members of the Corsican Assembly, who in turn determined the composition of the Executive Council of Corsica. The election was held only two years after the 2015 territorial elections, and were called as a result of the planned creation of a single collectivity within Corsica resulting from the mergers of two departments (Haute-Corse and Corse-du-Sud), and the existing territorial collectivity of Corsica.

zh.s: 科西嘉于2017年12月3日和10日举行领土议会选举，选出63名科西嘉议会议员，由他们决定科西嘉行政委员会的组成。距离上次2015年选举仅两年，这次提前选举是为配合计划中的行政重组：上科西嘉省、南科西嘉省与科西嘉现有领土行政机构将合并为单一地方行政单位。

en.s: The Ostrava hospital shooting was a mass shooting that occurred on 10 December 2019 at the Ostrava University Hospital in Ostrava, Czech Republic. The illegally armed perpetrator, 42-year-old Ctirad Vitásek, left the scene before the police arrived and committed suicide as police closed in on him later during the day.

en.s: During the late evening hours of December 10, 2021, a massive, long lived and devastating high-end EF4 tornado, sometimes referred to as the Western Kentucky tornado, Mayfield tornado, or The Beast, tracked a significant distance across Western Kentucky, United States, producing severe-to-catastrophic damage in numerous towns, including Mayfield, Princeton, Dawson Springs, and Bremen.

en.s: The 2022 NXT Deadline (stylized as DEADL1NE) was a professional wrestling event produced by WWE. It was the inaugural Deadline held for the promotion's developmental brand NXT.
